description: This file defines a custom subclass of torch.Tensor called TwoTensor, which holds two tensors and overrides tensor operations to run on both. It also defines a mode class for dispatching tensor operations. The file is part of the internal testing suite for PyTorch, focusing on tensor subclassing and dispatching mechanisms.

classes.name: TwoTensor
classes.description: A subclass of torch.Tensor that internally holds two tensors and runs operations on both.

classes.name: TwoTensorMode
classes.description: A torch dispatch mode that creates TwoTensor instances during tensor operations.
